scope: services/gateway only; existing infrastructure_probe.py and test_infrastructure_probe.py preserved

publicContractAuthority.validator: PublicContractPort.validate(contract_name, payload, schema_version='1.0.0') -> literal True only; every non-True value or exception fails closed
publicContractAuthority.codec: CanonicalCodecPort.encode(value) -> canonical JSON UTF-8 bytes; request_digest = raw SHA256 of those exact bytes; original source bytes have separate hashes
publicContractAuthority.time: PublicContractPort.epoch_ns(timestamp) -> exact integer epoch nanoseconds with authoritative @darkfactory/shared/vertex Gregorian/offset semantics; no floats or microsecond truncation
publicContractAuthority.implementationOwner: Main/native interop integration; no Python duplicate public schema, generated validator, fallback or runtime bridge is shipped here
publicContractAuthority.projection: project_public_status returns a frozen original payload only after literal-True authoritative validation. Public fields are unchanged; private detailed readiness dimensions do not become a second public schema. Infrastructure observed/authenticated handshake must not be interpreted as full readiness.

entrypoints.observe: GatewayObservationService(clock, policy, trust=None, observations=None, enabled=False).observe(GatewayTarget) -> ReadinessAssessment
entrypoints.assess: assess_readiness(target, snapshot, trust, policy, now_ns) -> ReadinessAssessment; pure and source-allowlisted
entrypoints.project: project_public_status(contracts, assessment, status_id=..., observed_at=..., recovery_phase=..., last_human_request_id=...) -> authoritative-validated immutable mapping
entrypoints.recover: RecoveryCoordinator(contracts=..., codec=..., clock=..., status=..., policy=RecoveryPolicy(), trust=None, authorization=None, safety=None, journal=None, audit=None, executor=None, reconciliation=None)
entrypoints.plan: coordinator.plan(request, target, operation=HUMAN_HANDOFF) -> nonexecutable RecoveryPlan; no trust transport, audit, authorization consume or executor call
entrypoints.attempt: coordinator.attempt(request, target, operation, ServerSession) -> RecoveryResult; disabled by default and no blind retry
entrypoints.reconcile: coordinator.reconcile(binding, admission) -> RecoveryResult; only proof-backed completion, no executor/authentication/rearm/kill reset
entrypoints.compatibility: vertex_gateway.compatibility.evaluate_compatibility(CompatibilityRequest(RuntimePins, receipts=())) -> CompatibilityAssessment; status UNKNOWN/BLOCKED/EVIDENCE_COMPLETE, runtime_compatibility_proven=False and trading_authorized=False always

identityAndReadiness.target: GatewayTarget(gateway_id, account_ref, Environment.PAPER|LIVE, GatewayProtocol.TWS_SOCKET|CLIENT_PORTAL_HTTP); account_ref is an opaque registry-issued acctref-64hex token, never a raw brokerage account or client-derived account hash
identityAndReadiness.evidence: One adapter-verified broker session generation per snapshot. Each dimension carries source/evidence registry refs and exact observed/received/expiry nanoseconds. Missing, stale, future, delayed, duplicate, untrusted, wrong-target or unidentified evidence cannot upgrade readiness.
identityAndReadiness.protocol: Client Portal HTTP and TWS socket identities are explicitly different; process presence, socket success and HTTP success are not authentication or account readiness.
identityAndReadiness.readOnly: Requires independently observed process/reachability/authentication/account/environment/read-only probe and current verified host trust. Execution reconciliation remains separate and cannot grant trading authority.
identityAndReadiness.externalPrerequisites: HostTrustPort must use provider-console verified host identity, strict pinned-host verification and HTTP TLS verification where applicable. It cannot establish trust on first use or suppress TLS/host warnings. Human login, 2FA and provider safety approval remain outside all adapters.

authorizationAndExecutionIntegration.serverStatus: GatewayStatusPort.current(target) supplies server-owned current BrokerRecoveryStatus. Request expectedStatusId must match; freshness and identity checked, and status/generation rechecked under local execution fence.
authorizationAndExecutionIntegration.session: ServerSession is an opaque authenticated-handler lookup handle, never a credential/bearer token. Construct in the authenticated CSRF-protected Civet handler; authorization port independently resolves current session, human principal, permissions and revocation.
authorizationAndExecutionIntegration.challenge: ServerAuthorizationPort.admit_once(session, binding, now_ns, guard_ref) atomically verifies an authenticated fresh interactive human challenge, exact session/actor/request-content/request-id/idempotency/gateway/protocol/opaque-account/environment/operation/expected-status binding, expiry and revocation; consumes the challenge and admits durable UNKNOWN before return. Public confirmation text, validation success, UI labels and model output are not authority.
authorizationAndExecutionIntegration.exactAction: Public RecoveryRequest.action=request-human-recovery does not authorize restart-gateway or rescan-read-only. Those operations need their own exact point-of-risk server challenge binding and explicit policy enablement. HUMAN_HANDOFF never dispatches or automates login.
authorizationAndExecutionIntegration.replayAndCrash: Durable uniqueness must cover globally consumed challenge, request/idempotency content and unresolved gateway/account attempt. Replay or unresolved attempts cannot be stolen after restart. Admission exception/lost acknowledgement is UNKNOWN and never automatically retried. No in-memory production authority or journal is provided.
authorizationAndExecutionIntegration.guard: ExecutionSafetyPort.hold(binding) is a local single-owner fenced context manager, not a cloud boolean. SafetyLease requires known-safe owner fencing, paused new risk, reconciled submission journal, no in-flight mutation, protection continuity and disruption safety. Guard must remain effective through executor action, which independently honors lease loss. Exit never rearms trading or resets the local kill switch.
authorizationAndExecutionIntegration.audit: AuditPort.append accepts only AuditEvent(event_code,target_digest,binding_digest,operation,environment,occurred_ns). No raw account, session, actor, challenge, request, endpoint, credential, authentication page, exception body or private route is logged. Durable pre-dispatch acknowledgement required.
authorizationAndExecutionIntegration.journal: RecoveryJournalPort.mark_dispatching CAS persists UNKNOWN before executor. mark_outcome records accepted/not-attempted/unknown only and cannot complete/release unresolved claims on timeout. mark_reconciled(binding,admission,proof,now_ns) separately CASes actual post-dispatch broker generation/time and human-reviewed proof. Failure stays uncertain.
authorizationAndExecutionIntegration.executor: RecoveryExecutorPort.dispatch_once(binding, admission, lease) is absent and disabled by default. Future implementation must perform at most one bounded attempt, no retry, auto-startup restart/rescan, authentication automation, order placement, cancellation, rearm or kill reset. ACK is reconciliation-required, not completed.
authorizationAndExecutionIntegration.reconciliation: ReconciliationPort supplies matching attempt/binding, fresh post-attempt broker facts, explicit human review and independent execution reconciliation. Journal must compare proof against actual stored dispatch time/generation. Completion restores connectivity only; trading remains disabled and kill switch unchanged.

compatibility.baseline: 1.231.0 is the source-observed non-prerelease Beta/legacy-Cython line, not proof of installed compatibility.
compatibility.candidate: 2.0.0rc5 is Rust/PyO3 prerelease; tagged Python >=3.12,<3.15 and Rust 1.98.1. Requires isolated research/paper environment and explicit scoped prerelease acceptance.
compatibility.pins: Exact package/source/wheel hashes, tag, Python ABI, Rust/Cargo lock, target platform, isolated environment, Gateway digest, broker config hash, opaque account_ref, client identity/ID and scope. Receipts bind all pins; opaque report-64hex references only.
compatibility.gates: Adapter/lifecycle/ordered events/financial parity/restart reconciliation/pacing/options+multi-leg/latency/rollback. rc5 adds release parity, copied-data migration, corrected/voided fills and legacy event restoration; v1 out-of-tree factories and PostgreSQL cache actor/strategy/heartbeat/synthetic restoration require specific additional evidence.
compatibility.limitations: No installed package/host check or report-content verification. Caller evidence metadata only; EVIDENCE_COMPLETE is not runtime readiness or authority. No deletion of authoritative old event rows.

sourceEvidence.decision: Gateway identity/readiness and explicit human recovery only; release-line migration and unresolved host/account state
Exact release lines, host trust, human challenge, and separate trading/kill authorities
Authoritative BrokerRecoveryStatus and RecoveryRequest; confirmation shape is not authenticated human authorization
Strict host verification and explicit uncertainty adapted as invariants; no source transport executed or copied into an automatic recovery path
Client Portal differs from native TWS; do not inherit TLS verification-off default or mistake read-only smoke scope for trading safety
Loopback/source authentication automation is evidence only; new native boundary has no login form/page/code/password handling
Read-only snapshot/reconciliation and unknown recovery semantics inform ports; execution obligations and trading authority remain with execution owner
Source mutation/recovery authority is not permission to port an autonomous order executor or rearm into gateway service

packaging.dependencies: Python standard library only; no broker SDK, SSH library, browser automation, web server or runtime dependency added
packaging.runtime: Integrate within native gateway service under Main's pinned Python toolchain; web/control remains Civet and existing public API. No second REST/BFF.
packaging.mainOwnedWork: Root service/package manifests, dependency lockfiles, native authoritative validation/codec/time bridge, server handler and durable challenge/journal adapters, local execution fence adapter, capability/config aggregation, final integration and verification

verification.sourceInspection: Scoped source and interface inspection only; no test, parser/compiler, formatter, linter, typecheck, build, install, generation, probe or runtime validation run
verification.fixtures: Synthetic dependency-injected port recorders; not public validators, production authorization stores or proof of durable crash/concurrency safety
requiredParentCoverage: Authoritative Civet/native validator, exact canonical bytes and nanosecond interop
Authenticated CSRF/session/challenge freshness, exact operation and account/environment status binding
Durable atomic challenge consumption and simultaneous/restarted request idempotency
Execution-owner fencing/protection continuity, lease loss and unknown send outcomes
Post-dispatch proof-aware reconciliation CAS and audit durability
Actual target protocol/account/environment readiness only after separately authorized transport integration

runtimeBlockers: Source and authored tests remain unexecuted and unvalidated until full buildout final gate.
Provider-console VPS fingerprint and strict host trust remain externally unverified; no SSH or host connection attempted.
No actual Gateway process, protocol endpoint, authenticated session, account/environment, read-only permissions or broker reconciliation observed.
No authoritative native validator/codec/time implementation or server authenticated challenge/durable admission adapters wired here.
No local execution safety/protection guard, production recovery journal/audit or post-attempt reconciliation adapter wired here.
All observation and recovery capabilities default disabled; no side-effecting transport implementation shipped or enabled.
No installed Nautilus baseline/candidate, exact host ABI/pins, prerelease approval or runtime parity/migration/restoration evidence established.
Human login/2FA/provider security checks and any future disruptive operation require actual human approvals; neither source changes nor a recovery request grant them.
Gateway recovery cannot rearm trading or reset the independent local kill switch.
